To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the relative SCN permeability and relative SCN conductance of bestrophin-Cl channels can be changed by mutation of amino acids in the second transmembrane helical domain of the channel, and the effects of mutation on anion selectivity are not due to a change in the pore size of the channel.
the second transmembrane segment (TMD2) of the bestrophin-1 (Best1) and bestrophin-3 (Best3) anion channels is a major determinant in an anion permeation pathway.

the permeability and conductivity of the bestrophin channel are determined by the size and charge of residues in the second transmembrane segment and that anion binding to the channel alters its gating properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the biophysical properties of bestrophin Cl channels.
the structure-function relationships of bestrophins, a family of proteins that are important for the physiology of the retina and other tissues.
the structure and function of a new family of anion-selective channels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the bestrophin family of Cl channels are highly permeable to anions, but the selectivity sequence is not well defined.
the selectivity of the bestrophin-1 channel depends on the amino acids at positions 78, 80, and 83 in TMD2.
the second transmembrane helix plays a major role in determining anion selectivity in bestrophin-Cl channels.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the permeation properties of bestrophin channels are determined by the properties of the entire protein, rather than by the contributions of individual residues.
TMD2 plays a major role in forming the pore, and that the major determinant of anion permeation is partitioning of anions into the pore.
bestrophin-1, -2, and -3 are anion-selective channels that share many properties, but also exhibit some differences in anion permeability, conductance, and gating.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TMD2 plays a critical role in determining anion permeation in bestrophins.
bestrophin-1 and -2 are not Cl channels but rather anion channels that have a very high Cl permeability and a low SCN permeability.
the bestrophin-1 channel has the same permeation and selectivity characteristics as the bestrophin channels in other species, and these are similar to the characteristics of the CIC-1 channel.
